import pandas as pd

def main(df):
    df_customers = pd.read_csv('customers.csv')
    df_orders = pd.read_csv('orders.csv')
    df_customers['customer_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_customers['customer_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    df_orders['customer_id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_orders['customer_id'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    if 'order_date' in df_orders.columns:
        df_orders['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_orders['order_date'], errors='coerce')
    if 'returned' in df_orders.columns:
        df_orders = df_orders[df_orders['returned'] == False]
    df_customers = df_customers.dropna(subset=['customer_id', 'segment'])
    df_orders = df_orders.dropna(subset=['customer_id', 'amount'])
    df_customers['segment'] = df_customers['segment'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_orders, df_customers, on='customer_id', how='inner', validate='many_to_one')
    result = df_merged.groupby('segment', as_index=False)['amount'].mean().rename(columns={'amount': 'average_order_amount'})
    result['average_order_amount'] = result['average_order_amount'].round(2)
    result = result.sort_values(by='average_order_amount', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    return result

    df2022 = pd.read_csv(path_2022, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)

    df = pd.concat([df2022, df2023], ignore_index=True)
    df['Outcome'] = df['Outcome'].astype('string').str.strip().str.title()
    df['Notes'] = df['Notes'].replace({'NULL': '', 'null': ''}, regex=True).astype('string').str.strip()
    df['Glucose'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Glucose'].astype(str), errors='coerce')
    df['visit_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['visit_date'].astype(str), errors='coerce')
    df['month'] = df['visit_date'].dt.month
    df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Outcome', 'Glucose', 'month'])

    outcome_codes = df_clean['Outcome'].astype('category').cat.codes
    corr_glucose = df_clean['Glucose'].corr(outcome_codes)
    corr_month = df_clean['month'].corr(outcome_codes)
    outcome_stats['outcome_glucose_corr'] = corr_glucose
    outcome_stats['outcome_month_corr'] = corr_month
    outcome_stats = outcome_stats.dropna(subset=['Outcome', 'patient_count', 'mean_glucose'])
